server_metrics.memory_caveat: Android emulator native process, /proc sampled ~1s; virtual RAM and CPU, not phone requirements; not app lifecycle/camera/GPU/NPU/thermal/power measurement.

active_run_notes: The initial full run started before metadata hardening changes. Native version writes stderr, so original runtime strings may be empty; verified same binary is documented here.

Native process is intentionally SIGTERMed during normal teardown; returncode143 alone is not OOM evidence. HTTP no-data read timeout180s and wall timeout300s are operational failures, not NONE or an accuracy score.
runtime_verification.verified_version_output:
version: 0.4.0-dev (build 10809, commit 5266f24da)
built with Clang 21.0.0 for Android aarch64

profile_state.reason: Full image cases took110–264s with~1.2GiB native swap on1CPU/4GB. Preserve these diagnostics; run complete suite in a separate temporary profile.

preference_verification.reason: The pre-restart run-as probes returned unknown package. Their identical SHA-256 values hashed error text, not XML. Preference preservation was not verified. No application was installed, uninstalled, cleared, or overwritten by this benchmark.

downstream.method_note: Existing Analyzer consumes model ingredients plus the original OCR text for warning statements. Vision rows are a hybrid integration simulation, not vision-only warning recognition or an APK integration test.

limitations: Only one real packaging photo; its OCR variants and rotations are correlated.
Pilot, full and timing scopes are distinct; pilot outputs do not fill full-suite gaps.
Operational errors/timeouts/loading failures have no measured quality score; they are not NONE.
CPU-only native Android emulator process; no physical phone/GPU/NPU/thermal/power/APK-lifecycle claims.
RSS/PSS/swap sampled approximately once per second; missing samples are unknown, not zero.
Exit code137 alone does not prove an out-of-memory kill;143 can be intentional SIGTERM teardown.
Mac Metal timings are a different backend and cannot predict handset performance.
